text.19:9: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
text.19:21: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
text.24:15: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.
